tasks.title: Wire init and summarize into Commander, update fallbacks
tasks.description:
Register init and summarize as native Commander commands and remove them from shell fallback maps.

Changes needed:

1. src/index.ts:
   - Import runInit from ./commands/init and runSummarize from ./commands/summarize
   - Add 'init' command: program.command('init').description('Initialize Ralph in the current project').action(() => runInit(...))
   - Add 'summarize' command: program.command('summarize').description('Update implementation documentation').action(() => runSummarize(...))
   - Remove 'init' and 'summarize' from SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS array
   - Note: init needs special handling — it should work WITHOUT an existing .ralph/ dir (setupProjectContext may need adjustment since findProjectRoot looks for .ralph/)

2. src/commands/fallback.ts:
   - Remove 'summarize' from COMMAND_SCRIPT_MAP
   - Remove 'init' from BIN_RALPH_COMMANDS

3. Update tests:
   - test/index.test.ts: update SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS expectations, add tests for init and summarize command registration
   - test/commands/fallback.test.ts: update expectations for removed entries
   - Verify RALPH_FORCE_SHELL=1 still delegates everything to shell (existing test should still pass)

Run the full test suite: bun test
tasks.notes: Imported runInit and runSummarize into src/index.ts. Registered both as native Commander commands. init creates a readline interface inline for the PromptInterface. summarize reads env vars set by preAction hook. Removed 'init' and 'summarize' from SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS (now ['plan','run','narrate']). Removed 'summarize' from COMMAND_SCRIPT_MAP and 'init' from BIN_RALPH_COMMANDS in fallback.ts. Updated all test expectations accordingly. All 270 tests pass.

tasks.title: Verify bun build --compile produces working binary
tasks.description:
Build the compiled binary and verify all commands work correctly.

1. Run: bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile dist/ralph
2. Test the compiled binary:
   - dist/ralph --version → should print version
   - dist/ralph status → should work (in a project with .ralph/)
   - dist/ralph edit → should work
   - dist/ralph logs → should work
   - dist/ralph init → should run interactive prompts (test in a temp dir)
   - dist/ralph summarize → should attempt to spawn claude (will fail without claude CLI, but verify it gets to the spawn step)
   - dist/ralph plan → should fall back to shell
   - dist/ralph run → should fall back to shell
3. Test RALPH_FORCE_SHELL=1 dist/ralph status → should delegate to shell
4. If any command fails in compiled form, investigate and fix the issue.

Run bun test first to make sure all tests pass, then build and do manual verification.

tasks.title: Fix bun PATH in health check execution environment
tasks.description: When ralph runs as an agent, bun is not in PATH (it lives at ~/.bun/bin/bun). The healthCheck in ralph.json uses 'bun build' which fails with 'command not found'. Options: (1) update ralph_config.sh or ralph_execute.sh to add ~/.bun/bin and ~/.cargo/bin to PATH before running health checks, (2) document that ralph.json healthCheck should use full path, or (3) auto-detect bun path in ralph_config.sh when building health check commands.
